input.body: Fixed in quillmark/markdown.py: inline() now swaps code spans and link opening tags (with their href) for placeholders before the strong/emphasis rules run, then restores them. Stars and underscores inside `code` and in link URLs are left untouched; link text and surrounding text are still formatted. Added regression tests in tests/test_markdown.py (code span with *, code span with _, URL with underscores, emphasis in link text, emphasis around code spans). Full pytest suite passes (43 passed).

content.text:
QUILL-31 is fixed and closed. The full pytest suite passes (43 tests), and I commented on the issue with what changed.

- **Open issues:** QUILL-31 (the bug), QUILL-34 (`draft: true` in front matter), QUILL-36 (split `to_html` into per-block handlers) and QUILL-38 (README template variables). I only worked on QUILL-31.
- **Tests first:** I added five tests to `tests/test_markdown.py`. They cover `*` and `_` inside code spans, underscores in a link URL, emphasis in link text, and emphasis around code spans. All five failed before the fix.
- **Fix:** In `quillmark/markdown.py`, `inline()` now swaps code spans and link opening tags (including the href) for placeholders before the strong and emphasis rules run. It restores them afterwards. Link text and the text around code spans are still formatted.

I haven't committed anything.
